title: Sources: China is considering how to build fences around its AI know-how amid the AI race and is identifying standout companies to add to an export control list (Wall Street Journal)
summary: Wall Street Journal: Sources: China is considering how to build fences around its AI know-how amid the AI race and is identifying standout companies to add to an export control list — Beijing worries $2.5 billion acquisition of startup Manus will encourage more entrepreneurs to follow in its footsteps
